title: Khadijah's Steady Support
paragraphs: As a successful and respected merchant in her own right, Khadijah occupied a position of considerable independence and influence long before her marriage to the Prophet ﷺ brought her further historical significance.

When the Prophet ﷺ first received revelation, an experience that left him deeply shaken and uncertain, Khadijah's calm, immediate reassurance provided emotional stability during one of the most disorienting moments of his life.

Rather than reacting with doubt or fear, she consulted a knowledgeable relative to better understand what was happening, demonstrating a practical, thoughtful response rather than a purely emotional one during genuine uncertainty.

Throughout the following years, as opposition to the growing faith intensified, Khadijah consistently used her own wealth and social standing to shield and support the small early community during its most vulnerable period.

Her unwavering support during this formative period is widely regarded as instrumental, providing not just financial protection but the emotional steadiness that allowed the fragile early community to survive its hardest years.

Historians studying this period often emphasize that her contribution, though less publicly visible than some other events, was foundational to the survival and eventual growth of the entire early Muslim community.
